Accessibility guide

The Jukebox is built for blind and low-vision users first. Every picture has a spoken or written equivalent.

Keyboard shortcuts

Keyboard shortcuts
SpacePlay or pause
← / →Previous or next track
Tab / Shift+TabMove between controls
Enter / Space on a buttonActivate it

Space and the arrow keys are ignored while a dropdown, slider or button has focus, so they never fight with those controls.

Screen reader support

  • A text description of what you're hearing updates every three seconds in a polite live region.
  • Turn on Screen Reader in the player to have the browser speak those descriptions aloud, even without a screen reader running.
  • The visualization canvas has a text label naming the track and data source. The audio bars are hidden because the description covers them.
  • Track changes are announced.

Visual comfort

  • Yellow focus ring on every control.
  • Light text on a dark background for strong contrast.
  • Animations stop if your system asks for reduced motion.
  • Playback speed (0.5x to 2x) and volume are adjustable; mute is one button.

Found a barrier? Tell the team so it can be fixed.
